summary_1line: As Rama and Ravana engage in a fierce chariot duel, ominous supernatural portents arise foretelling Ravana’s impending downfall.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama and Ravana face each other on speeding chariots amid a storm of arrows while gods gather in the sky to watch the duel.
Dark vultures circle above Ravana’s chariot as blood rains down and meteors streak across the dimmed sky over Lanka.
Matali drives Indra’s chariot past Ravana’s with blinding speed, the wheels throwing dust across the battlefield.
